claim_scores.rationale: Uses `dspy.ChatAdapter().format_system_message(...)` on both signatures and never invokes an LM call.
Defines a signature with `code: dspy.Code = dspy.OutputField()` and asserts the rendered system message includes the markdown code block instruction.
Asserts the code-system prompt excludes both `JSON schema` guidance and dumped schema text like `"properties"`, matching the `Code` special case.
Defines a structured `pydantic.BaseModel` output path and asserts the prompt includes `must adhere to the JSON schema` plus inline schema JSON via `"properties"`.
